name: XR-PPT Player
summary:
The XR-PPT Player as the dedicated VR headset client of the XR Resource Collaboration Platform, offers powerful features for a rich and convenient resource viewing experience. 

Users can easily browse various resources on the platform, including VR courseware, images in multiple formats, PPT presentations, stunning panoramic images, realistic panoramic videos, and detailed 3D models. The platform supports one-click import and secondary editing of Office and WPS files. It supports model import and zero-code
